verdict.rationale: Emergency-stop and safety-interlock patterns are a fair question for a robot fleet and teleoperation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no Formant documentation of an e-stop, safety interlock, deadman switch, or connection-loss safe-stop behavior. Generic custom commands, teleop buttons and event-triggered commands are developer building blocks for constructing such patterns, not documented safety support, so they earn no credit.
